title: Type it once
caption: The rent is the same on the 5th every month. Kavita types it once. Lumi tells her story.
linkedin_text: In ScoreMyBiz, when an owner records a fixed monthly cost such as rent, salary or an instalment, he can choose 'Yes, every month'. It is added to the book by itself on his chosen day, and he can pause or stop it. A removal can be undone for five seconds.

cast.kavita: Kavita, a middle-aged Indian tailor who runs a boutique, in a rust-coloured cotton kurta with a measuring tape around her neck

scenes.clip: Lumi, a young Indian woman with long dark hair in a navy blazer and white top, facing the camera in a tailoring boutique with bolts of colourful cloth and sewing machines behind her, a warm smile.
